stories.title: Português DJ Ride é campeão do Mundo: "Trabalhei imenso durante anos"
stories.summary: Portuguese DJ, producer and sound engineer DJ Ride won the Open category at the 41st DMC World DJ Championships, held at KOKO in London. The article calls DMC the most prestigious international DJ competition, held since 1985, and notes he already holds five world scratch titles and four IDA world titles. He says he trained hard for years, will probably skip competing next year to become a judge, and is working on DJ tools including a competition vinyl, a new album and his work with Beatbombers.

stories.title: Berlin techno DJ and producer Jamaica Suk has died
stories.summary: Berlin-based techno DJ and producer Jamaica Suk has died after a battle with an aggressive form of breast cancer, her family and friends confirmed on her Instagram on Monday, November 24. Originally from Northern California, she played clubs including RSO, Tresor, about blank and Renate, was a long-time resident at Pornceptual, and founded the vinyl label Gradient. Memorial arrangements will be shared on her Instagram, and the family has asked for privacy.

stories.title: Federal Judge Rejects Lowery v. Suno Dismissal Amid NIL Battle
stories.summary: Judge Angel Kelley denied AI music company Suno's motion to dismiss the class action led by Jason Isbell and David Lowery, which alleges name, image and likeness violations across at least 15 states and territories. The amended complaint's plaintiffs include The Chicks and Dirty Projectors, and it argues that Suno's label licensing deals with Warner, Believe and BMG do not cover performers' personal likeness rights. The full order had not been released at press time.

stories.title: The Prodigy cancel Amsterdam and Brussels shows, ending European tour early
stories.summary: The Prodigy cancelled the final two dates of their European tour, Brussels (Forest National, 27 November) and Amsterdam (28 November), on doctors' orders, days after calling off Prague and Vienna due to illness. The band did not say which member is unwell. The ten-date tour began in Oslo on 14 November and was their first proper headline European tour in about three years.

stories.title: UX Arena, a new 40,000-capacity venue, opens in the Tulum jungle on NYE
stories.summary: Universal Xperience, which acquired Zamna earlier this year, will open UX Arena, a 40,000-capacity venue on a former limestone quarry between Playa del Carmen and Tulum, on December 31 with RENAISSANCE Tulum NYE featuring Sasha, Maceo Plex, Sébastien Léger and Ida Engberg. The site has three stages, and UX says no forest will be cleared because it is built on the old quarry. The January season includes Amnesia, Anyma, Black Coffee, Adriatique and Adam Port.

stories.title: PLEASE DO NOT DISTURB: Novo conceito de evento de música eletrónica estreia-se em Lisboa com RIVO
stories.summary: Promoter Sodade launches a new electronic event concept, 'please do not disturb', with its first edition on 19 December 2026 at LX Factory in Lisbon. French DJ and producer RIVO (known for his 2024 remix of Disclosure's 'You & Me') headlines, joined by the Portuguese duo Mayze x Faria (from Braga), French producer Max Arthur and Portuguese DJ JÖAH, founder of Soulset. The concept's motto is 'disconnect to connect'. Tickets are on sale via sodade.bol.pt, and the article is based on a press release.

stories.title: Hard Techno Party Teletech Expects to Sell Close to 500,000 Tickets in 2026
stories.summary: Billboard reports that Teletech, the Manchester hard techno brand founded by Anton Stevens and Tom Shelton and run by a team of five, expects to sell about half a million tickets in 2026, with events across Europe, South America, Australia and the US plus its own label, Teletech Records. Upcoming dates include a Space Miami party on 27 November 2026 and the Fresh Start New Year's event at The Warehouse on Pier 80 in San Francisco on 2 January 2027, where about 20,000 attendees are expected.

stories.title: Suno: A Reflection of Our Own Lack of Creativity?
stories.summary: An opinion piece by Shana Bize on producers' anxiety about the AI music generator Suno. It cites a 2026 study by David Dalmazzo and colleagues of more than 60,000 tracks (about 20,000 each from Suno, Udio and human composers), which found that Suno output showed more restricted harmonic and structural diversity, an effect the researchers call 'output homogenization'. It notes that producers such as Alan Braxe, Fred Falke and Todd Edwards have used Suno, and argues that artistic intention matters more than simplicity. The piece closes by promoting the outlet's own AI-assisted production service, PURE BPM.

stories.title: EVAYA arruma o pseudónimo e passa a assinar como Beatriz Bronze
stories.summary: Portuguese producer, composer and singer EVAYA is retiring her six-year-old alias and will now release music and perform as Beatriz Bronze. Her back catalogue stays online under the new credit. Her first concert under that name is on 31 December 2026 at RCA in Porto, at the RAVE ALHÃO party, mixing songs from her 2024 album 'Abaixo Das Raízes Deste Jardim' (Saliva Diva) with unreleased material from a follow-up album planned for 2027.

stories.title: "300 nerds with Claude are going to outcompete any synth manufacturer on the market": The AI revolution is coming for your electronic instruments
stories.summary: AI-assisted coding tools have made it much easier to modify the firmware of hardware instruments, and modding communities have grown around devices such as Elektron's Octatrack and M-VAVE's FM-1. Elektron has banned sharing modified firmware on its official forum, citing copyright and the risk of bricked hardware. Akai has instead released SDKs and plans to design future products with customisation in mind.

stories.title: Festival CRSSD anuncia a programação da primavera de 2027
stories.summary: CRSSD Festival has announced its spring 2027 lineup for 13–14 March 2027 at Waterfront Park, San Diego, across three stages: Ocean View, City Steps and The Palms. Names include Eric Prydz, Adam Beyer, Sven Väth, Indira Paganotto, Ellen Allien b2b Marcel Dettmann, Dubfire b2b Nicole Moudaber, Maceo Plex, DJ Heartstring and Josh Baker. The article puts Portuguese techno act ØTTA in the underground/eclectic section and calls them 'a força do techno português'.

stories.title: Benjamin Clementine arranca em Braga digressão com 13 concertos em Portugal
stories.summary: Benjamin Clementine has announced 'Back to Basics', a solo piano tour that opens on 1 April 2027 at Fórum Braga and ends on 30 May in Bilbao. It has 13 Portuguese dates, including Porto, Lisbon, Viana do Castelo, Faro, Coimbra and the Azores. Tickets go on sale Friday, 27 November. This is the story behind the 'benjamin clementine' Google Trends spike in Portugal, but it is not electronic music.

stories.title: Tidal vai eliminar do catálogo a música gerada inteiramente por inteligência artificial
stories.summary: From 9 December, Tidal will remove fully AI-generated tracks and stop accepting new ones. Music where AI only assisted a human artist is still allowed. About 6% of its catalogue (around 27 million tracks) carries its AI label, and the label hit an average of 43% of new uploads over the past 90 days, going above 60% on 6 November. Suno accounts for 94% of flagged tracks, 96% of which had no plays in 90 days. Tidal expects to reject 80,000 to 85,000 songs a day and wants the affected tracks gone by early 2027.
